basis: The mission page calls Viafarini an Associazione APS founded in 1991 and the team page lists its Consiglio direttivo and president.

The notarial deed of 27 April 2022 (pages 1 to 3) names Maurizio Morra Greco as founder and records entry in the Campania register of legal persons and the application to the national third sector register; the history page says the foundation was established in 2003 by Maurizio Morra Greco.
The museum's own page on the foundation (archived copy) says Regione Campania set up the Fondazione Donnaregina on 22 November 2004 and reformed its statute in 2011.

The FACT page says the foundation was set up in 2015 at the wish of the Comune di Prato and is a public-participation foundation of the Comune, and the transparency page calls it a private body under public control.

red_tape.note: Artribune reported in February 2013 that the museum's workers wrote an open letter saying its operating structure no longer wants to be penalised by political and administrative slowness of the competent bodies.

basis: Governance: the 2022-2024 anticorruption plan (article 5) gives the legal form and staff contract, the director notice quotes statute article 32, and the transparency page cites Legislative Decree 33/2013 and carries the access request form. Red tape: Artribune article of 1 February 2013.
The mission page calls the foundation an ente no profit and the 2024 financial statement (page 1) is headed Fondazione Pastificio Cerere Onlus.

The museum's page calls it an office of general management level of the Ministero della Cultura with organisational, financial and accounting autonomy, and the ministry's entry lists it as an institute with special autonomy.
